ivRank.source: VIX close, the 30-day implied of SPX

sign: call gamma is negative and put gamma is positive, the house sign
note: Cash SPX. Oct 27 has not opened, so the intraday tape is the Oct 26 session. IV rank is a year of VIX closes, the 30-day implied of SPX. The scorecard is the 0DTE at-the-money call's first quoted IV that morning, not the crushed close.
